title: Run uncurated fingerprint holdout with typed evidence ranking
description: Second TASK-256 indexing experiment. Use older completed tasks with deterministic, uncurated fingerprints; have one fresh visible read-only helper independently author paraphrased holdout queries and expected evidence, freeze that truth set, then have a different fresh visible read-only helper evaluate query packets. Add query-aware typed evidence-role ranking without modifying TASK-256 outputs. Measure task recall/selection, exact evidence visibility/selection, token use, latency, path health, and scope adherence. Do not integrate into startup, routing, Command Center, or external services.
acceptance_criteria: An independent fresh helper authors the paraphrased query and expected-source truth set from an older completed-task corpus before the evaluator or ranking analysis sees it.
The generated fingerprints use deterministic task records without owner-curated semantic fields, and the source ranker labels evidence roles and what each source can prove.

A different fresh helper receives only the frozen compact retrieval packet, performs no broad repository search or writes, and reports task/source selections, confidence, and uncertainty under the token budget.
The final report compares task and evidence recall/precision, token use, latency, path health, and limitations against TASK-256, preserving negative results and making no integration claim.
